daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

Vice President Gibran reaffirmed governance reforms for the government's flagship MBG (free nutritious meals) and KDMP (free milk for students) programs, with the government estimating that efficiency measures could save Rp 1 trillion per month from the state budget. President Prabowo led an evaluation meeting on the 2026 hajj pilgrimage, directing officials to cut waiting queues and improve coordination, with the hajj waiting period reduced from 40 to 26 years though the president requested further cuts.

  • Commission XIII of the DPR approved a budget ceiling of Rp 25.3 trillion for the Ministry of Immigration and Correctional Institutions (Kemenimipas) for 2027.
  • The Ministry of Social Affairs requested an increased budget of Rp 8 trillion for the Sekolah Rakyat (People's Schools) program in 2027, while the ministry's Social Affairs Minister assured that efficiency measures would not reduce the number of social aid recipients or affect the school program.
  • The Ministry of Law and Human Rights requested an additional budget of Rp 837.1 billion for various programs.
  • The DPR's Special Committee on Hajj reported that regular hajj pilgrims were accommodated in five-star hotels during the 2026 pilgrimage.
  • The DPR passed a revision to the Cooperatives Law featuring 118 amendments and 3 transitional provisions, which the government hopes will develop village cooperatives under the Kopdes Merah Putih program.
  • The Constitutional Court ordered a revision of the Advocates Law within two years to improve lawyer organization structures.
  • The KPK chairman said the agency would scrutinize the Director General of Customs after his name surfaced in a court hearing, saying the matter would not be dismissed.
  • The Attorney General's Office sealed a warehouse containing electric motorcycles belonging to BGN (the National Food Barn agency) in Sentul.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia's Finance Minister met with China's Finance Minister in Beijing to deepen funding ties between the two countries. Indonesia also called for a joint ASEAN AI framework to bridge the digital divide across the region.

  • The Indonesian ambassador commented that the visit of HMS Tamar demonstrates the strengthening relationship between Indonesia and the UK, with Britain committed to supporting Indonesia in maintaining sustainable maritime resources.
  • Air Marshal Muzafar was officially installed as Commander of the Joint Defense Area Command II (Pangkogabwilhan II) in a ceremony led by the Deputy Chief of Staff of the Indonesian Armed Forces.
  • The Indonesian ambassador reported that the first vessel of Indonesia's fishing fleet will be completed by the end of this year, while also pushing for enhanced cooperation with Japan to strengthen economic resilience.
  • The Minister of Migrant Workers Protection sent off 313 migrant workers to Japan as Indonesia seeks to expand professional worker placements to Europe through the GSP program.

Other

Bottled drinking water products will be required to meet SNI standards starting in October 2026, while the government also mandated that e-commerce sellers must obtain a Business Identification Number (NIB). The Education Ministry allocated Rp 7.21 trillion to build 100 integrated national schools for students with high academic abilities.

  • The government disbursed US$54.5 million for socio-economic recovery in Sumatra, with the Social Affairs Ministry separately distributing Rp 1 trillion for continued Sumatra recovery efforts and sending tents and food aid to areas affected by a magnitude 6.7 earthquake in Central Sulawesi.
  • The Agriculture Ministry targets garlic self-sufficiency within three years as part of national food security efforts.
  • Indonesia will continue purchasing oil from Russia even after the Strait of Hormuz reopened.
  • The Constitutional Court rejected a challenge to provisions in the Marriage Law requiring husbands to provide for their wives.
  • Indonesia's traditional tempe is one step closer to being recognized as a UNESCO world cultural heritage item.
